earnings.title: CJ (Chaitanya Jain)
highlights: Operating Income of $21 Billion and Diluted EPS of $44.75
$19.12 billion net income attributable to common stockholders and $44.75 diluted EPS in the third quarter of 2026
Operating Income: Operating income for the third quarter of 2026 was $20.91 billion, compared to $3.89 billion of operating income for the third quarter of 2025.

Operating income for the third quarter of 2026 includes a gain on the Company’s digital assets of $20.91 billion, compared to a gain on the Company’s digital assets of $3.89 billion for the third quarter of 2025.
Returned STRC to health by executing $2.04 billion (1) of repurchases and growing USD Assets to $5.07 billion, providing 3.4 years of coverage on dividend and interest obligations

quotes.text: Strategy demonstrated its commitment to returning STRC to health. We grew our USD Assets to $5.1 billion, increased USD Duration to 3.4 years, and repurchased $2.0 billion of STRC.
quotes.by: Phong Le, President and Chief Executive Officer

quotes.text: Q3 operating income of $21 billion was the largest ever in Strategy’s history. We've also raised $21 billion of equity capital and increased our bitcoin holdings by 26% year-to-date in a challenging bitcoin market.
